terms.source_pdf: Baby room planning - Autumn term 1 - Space.pdf

days.title: Space playdough with tools
days.role_of_adult: Make homemade playdough, adding black paint and silver glitter. Allow the children to explore the playdough using the tools provided.

days.title: '5 Little Men in a Flying Saucer'
days.role_of_adult: Sing at circle time with enthusiasm.

days.title: Space Star Printing
days.role_of_adult: Provide card, paint and star-shaped cookie cutters. Encourage the children to dip the star into the paint and print it onto their card.

days.title: Space Toys
days.role_of_adult: Provide the small world space toys and tent and allow the children to explore.

days.title: 'Zoom to the Moon' by Pat-A-Cake
days.role_of_adult: Read at circle time with enthusiasm.

days.title: Exploring Moon (kinetic) Sand
days.role_of_adult: Provide moon sand for the children with tools and allow them to explore.

days.title: Space Dance Party
days.role_of_adult: Turn on the disco light, the space light, play some space themed music and encourage the children to dance!

days.title: Painting Toilet Rolls for Telescopes
days.role_of_adult: Provide some toilet rolls and paint. Allow the children to decorate their toilet roll. Encourage them to look through them like telescopes.

days.title: Space Dress Up
days.role_of_adult: Provide some space dressing up resources and encourage the children to attempt to put some things on independently.

days.title: 'Where's Mr Astronaut' by Ingela Arrhenius
days.role_of_adult: Read at circle time with enthusiasm.

days.title: Space Cornflour Play
days.role_of_adult: Mix up some cornflour gloop with some food colouring and glitter, adding some space figures. Allow the children to explore using their hands and tools.

days.title: Counting Aliens/Astronauts (Emptying and Filling)
days.role_of_adult: Provide the buckets, bangles and aliens and astronauts from pre-school. Encourage the children to empty and fill, counting how many they have.

days.title: Making Tin Foil Stars
days.role_of_adult: Cut black card into star shapes and provide tin foil and glue. Help the children to put glue on the card and place some foil on top.

days.title: Space Rocket Pretend Play
days.role_of_adult: Set up the room like a rocket; put the baby gym in the middle of the room and cover it with an emergency blanket. Add the light up pebbles and play some space sounds from Alexa.

days.title: '8 Little Planets' by Chris Ferrie
days.role_of_adult: Sing at circle time with enthusiasm.

terms.source_pdf: Baby Room Planning - Autumn Term 2 - Light & Celebration.pdf

days.title: Glow Stick Bottles
days.role_of_adult: Collect empty water bottles (plastic VOS ones) and put glow sticks inside. Turn the lights off and encourage the children to shake the bottles, looking at the lights and different colours.

days.title: Rolling light up balls
days.role_of_adult: Provide some light up balls and encourage the children to roll them back and forth either with each other or a staff member.

days.title: Firework blotching
days.role_of_adult: Provide the children with black card and metallic blotchers. Allow the children to make marks.

days.title: Playdough birthday cakes
days.role_of_adult: Set up the playdough at the table with some tools. Encourage the children to make 'birthday cakes' and sing happy birthday.

days.title: 'Twinkly, Twinkly Night-Time' by Sam Taplin
days.role_of_adult: Read at circle time with enthusiasm.

days.title: Light up balloons
days.role_of_adult: Provide balloons with lights inside. Make the room dark so that the lights can be seen. Encourage the children to play and explore.

days.title: Light dance party
days.role_of_adult: Darken the room, turn on the disco light, provide torches and play familiar music. Allow the children to make sounds and explore the lights.

days.title: Handprint turkeys
days.role_of_adult: Use the children's hands and paint to make turkeys for Thanksgiving!

days.title: Small world arctic animals
days.role_of_adult: Set up blue water and the arctic animals in the messy play tray. Allow the children to explore, talking about the colour of the water, the temperature and the different animals.

days.title: 'Busy Hanukkah'
days.role_of_adult: Read at circle time with enthusiasm.

blocks.header: W/C: 30th November + 7th December 2026 Theme: Light & Celebration

days.title: Christmas decorations exploration
days.role_of_adult: Provide different Christmas decorations e.g. tinsel, baubles, jingle bells, etc. and allow the children to explore the different sounds and textures.

days.title: Dancing and freezing with lights
days.role_of_adult: Turn off the lights and give the children a torch. Play some music and pause it in intervals, encouraging the children to also freeze with their torches.

days.title: Christmas cards
days.role_of_adult: Complete Christmas cards with the children to give to their families.

days.title: Christmas market pretend play
days.role_of_adult: Set up the home corner with a mix of pretend food and real food. Provide the children with baskets and encourage them to collect food in their baskets as if they are shopping.

days.title: 'Busy Christmas' by Campbell Books
days.role_of_adult: Read at circle time with enthusiasm.

terms.source_pdf: Baby Room Planning - Spring Term 1 - Animals & Habitats.pdf

days.title: Flower and bug sensory garden
days.role_of_adult: Set up the messy play tray with fake grass and flowers. Add in some toy insects and encourage the children to explore.

days.title: Animal movements and sounds
days.role_of_adult: Get out the animal hats and tails from the dressing up resources. Encourage the children to wear them and make the different sounds while walking and moving like the animals.

days.title: Animal feet printing
days.role_of_adult: Provide some paint, animals and card. Encourage the children to dip the animals into the paint and print with their feet on to the card.

days.title: Marine animals water play
days.role_of_adult: Set up the water tray with blue water and the marine animals. Allow the children to explore. Talk about the different animals.

days.title: 'Brown Bear, Brown Bear What Do You See?' By Bill Martin, Jr.
days.role_of_adult: Read at circle time with enthusiasm, encouraging the children to name the animals that they recognise.

days.title: Farm animals with shredded paper
days.role_of_adult: Set up the messy tray with farm animals. Add shredded paper, this will resemble hay. Allow the children to explore. Talk about the different animals and the sounds they make.

days.title: '5 Little Ducks'
days.role_of_adult: Sing with enthusiasm, encouraging the children to count, sing along and copy the actions.

days.title: Colouring animals
days.role_of_adult: Print off some animal colouring sheets and provide some felt tip pens. Allow the children to mark make.

days.title: Safari small world play
days.role_of_adult: Set up the safari animals from pre-school and encourage the children to explore. Talk about what animals they can see and their sounds.

days.title: 'The Very Hungry Caterpillar' by Eric Carle
days.role_of_adult: Read at circle time with enthusiasm using the story sack, ensuring that each child is given a prop.

days.title: Green spaghetti jungle
days.role_of_adult: Cook some spaghetti then add food colouring to turn it green. Put it in the messy play tray and add jungle animals. Allow the children to explore the texture of the spaghetti and the different animals.

days.title: 'Hop Little Bunnies'
days.role_of_adult: Play the song 'Hop Little Bunnies' and encourage the children to lie down then get up and start jumping, modelling what to do.

days.title: Decorating animal masks
days.role_of_adult: Buy some plain white animal masks and provide crafting resources. Encourage the children to decorate their masks. Allow the children to wear their masks and make animal sounds and movements.

days.title: Washing animals
days.role_of_adult: Fill the messy tray with soapy water, sponges and animals. Encourage the children to use the sponges to clean the animals.

days.title: 'Monkey Puzzle' by Julia Donaldson
days.role_of_adult: Read at circle time. Encourage the children to join in e.g. "no, no, no!"

terms.source_pdf: Baby Room Planning - Spring Term 2 - All Things Sensory.pdf

blocks.header: W/C: 22nd February + 1st March 2027 Theme: All Things Sensory

days.title: Oil and paint ziplock bags
days.role_of_adult: Fill some ziplock bags with baby oil and paint. Ensure that they are secure and allow the children to explore, using their hands to maneuver the oil and paint inside. Talk about the different colours.

days.title: Fruit tasting
days.role_of_adult: Cut up different fruits and encourage the children to taste them. Preferably using fruit that we normally would not have at nursery.

days.title: Making sensory bottles
days.role_of_adult: Provide empty water bottles (plastic VOS ones) and some resources to put inside of them (rice, spaghetti, sequins, lego, glitter, etc). Allow the children to put the bits inside the bottles and shake them to make sounds.

days.title: Herb garden pretend play
days.role_of_adult: Set up the home corner and add some real herbs. Allow the children to explore and smell the different herbs.

days.title: 'See, Touch, Feel' by Priddy Books
days.role_of_adult: Read at circle time.

blocks.header: W/C: 8th + 15th March 2027 Theme: All Things Sensory

days.title: Ice exploration play
days.role_of_adult: Make some ice cubes and put them in the messy play tray. Allow the children to explore.

days.title: Building with sensory blocks
days.role_of_adult: Provide the sensory blocks and encourage the children to build towers. Model this behaviour.

days.title: Making sensory pictures
days.role_of_adult: Provide different sensory materials and PVA glue. Allow the children to glue their card and place the materials on top to make sensory pictures.

days.title: Rice krispies/oats and diggers
days.role_of_adult: Set up the messy tray with rice krispies/oats and add some diggers. Allow the children to explore.

days.title: 'Baby's Very First Musical Playbook' by Usborne
days.role_of_adult: Read at circle time and encourage singing and dancing along to the sounds in the book.

blocks.header: W/C: 22nd + 29th March 2027 Theme: All Things Sensory

days.title: Heuristic play
days.role_of_adult: Provide the heuristic resources and allow the children to explore.

days.title: Colour sorting caterpillar
days.role_of_adult: Get out the colour sorting caterpillar and encourage the children to match each object with the correct colour. Provide lots of praise and support.

days.title: Hand painting
days.role_of_adult: Set up some paint and card. Encourage the children to dip their hands into the paint and print/make marks on their card.

days.title: Sensory car wash
days.role_of_adult: Set up the messy tray with soapy water and sponges and provide cars and towels. Encourage the children to wash the cars using the sponges and soapy water, then dry them using the towels provided.

days.title: 'Noisy Farm'
days.role_of_adult: Read at circle time, encouraging the children to repeat the animal names and make the sounds.

terms.source_pdf: Baby Room Planning - Summer Term 1 - Transport and Journeys.pdf

days.title: Toy cars in kinetic sand
days.role_of_adult: Set up the messy tray with kinetic sand and add some care. Encourage the children the explore, rolling the cars back and forth in the sand.

days.title: Parking cars on numbered spaces
days.role_of_adult: Get some card and number parking spaces. Provide some cars and support the children to park the cars into the numbered spaces.

days.title: Painting with car wheels
days.role_of_adult: Provide paint pots and cars. Encourage the children to dip the cars into paint and make marks with the wheels on card.

days.title: Washing cars
days.role_of_adult: Set up the messy tray with soapy water, sponges and cars. Encourage the children to use the sponges to clean the cars and dry them using towels.

days.title: 'We're Going on a Bear Hunt' by Michael Wayne Rosen
days.role_of_adult: Read at circle time with enthusiasm.

blocks.header: W/C: 26th April + 3rd May 2027 Theme: Transport + Journeys

days.title: Airplanes in shaving foam
days.role_of_adult: Set up the messy tray with shaving foam and airplanes. Allow the children to explore.

days.title: Rolling tyres
days.role_of_adult: Using the tyres in the garden, stand them up and encourage the children to roll them.

days.title: Drawing with cars
days.role_of_adult: Tape pens to cars and encourage the children to push the cars back and forth to make marks.

days.title: Trains small world
days.role_of_adult: Provide the trains small world, encouraging the children to help set up the tracks and push the trains along.

days.title: 'Peppa Goes on Holiday'
days.role_of_adult: Read at circle time.

days.title: Boats in water
days.role_of_adult: Set up the messy tray with water, adding blue food colouring. Add some boats and allow the children to explore.

days.title: Car rolling ramps
days.role_of_adult: Set up the ramps in the garden and provide the cars. Encourage the children to roll the cars down the ramps.

days.title: Sticking transport pictures
days.role_of_adult: Collect magazines and cut out pictures of transport. Provide card and PVA and allow the children to stick the transport pictures.

days.title: Airport and airplanes
days.role_of_adult: Provide the airport and airplanes small world toys from pre-school. Allow the children to explore and play.

days.title: 'Things That Go' by Campbell Books
days.role_of_adult: Read at circle time, encouraging the children to copy the names of the transport.

terms.source_pdf: Baby Room Planning - Summer Term 2 - Let's Get Physical!.pdf

blocks.header: W/C: 31st May + 7th June 2027 Theme: Let's Get Physical!

days.title: Shaving foam and sand
days.role_of_adult: Set up the messy tray with shaving foam. Add some sand for texture. Allow the children to explore.

days.title: Obstacle course
days.role_of_adult: Set up an obstacle course in the garden and encourage the children to have a go, supporting them where needed.

days.title: Large scale drawing
days.role_of_adult: Set large pieces of card on the floor and provide felt tip pens. Allow the children to make marks.

days.title: Hairdressers pretend play
days.role_of_adult: Provide the hairdressers resources and encourage the children to explore and play.

days.title: 'Busy Sports Day' by Campbell Books
days.role_of_adult: Read at circle time.

blocks.header: W/C: 14th + 21st June 2027 Theme: Let's Get Physical!

days.title: Toilet roll play
days.role_of_adult: Provide some toilet rolls. Allow the children to roll them around the room and explore the tissue.

days.title: Pots and pans play
days.role_of_adult: Provide some pots and pans and wooden spoons. Encourage the children to bang the pots and pans using the wooden spoons to make different sounds.

days.title: Feet painting
days.role_of_adult: Set up large pieces of card on the floor and some paint. Take off the children's socks and encourage them to step into the paint, making marks on the card.

days.title: Princess/dragons and castles small world.
days.role_of_adult: Bring over the princesses, dragons and castles small world from pre-school. Allow the children to explore.

days.title: 'Daddy Pig's Fun Run'
days.role_of_adult: Read at circle time.

blocks.header: W/C: 28th June + 5th July 2027 Theme: Let's Get Physical!

days.title: Homemade playdough
days.role_of_adult: Mix up some playdough and allow the children to explore. Provide rolling pins, cookie cutters and stampers.

days.title: Running games in the garden
days.role_of_adult: Encourage the children to run around the garden, shouting "stop" and "go!"

days.title: Mark making using paint sticks
days.role_of_adult: Provide some card and the paint sticks, allowing the children to make marks.

days.title: Doctors pretend play
days.role_of_adult: Provide the doctors pretend play resources and encourage the children to explore and play.

days.title: 'Spot Loves Sport'
days.role_of_adult: Read at circle time.
